name: black-sun
author: Lil Art
description: Black Sun: a solo or party instance on Mt. Mjolnir. James Wolf was bitten by a werewolf in the mountains, and the Black Sun is rising. Talk to his older brother John Wolf in Prontera (113, 190), break the Pack with your cousin-guide Nightwing, climb to the summit and face James, the Black Sun. Every party gets its own copy of the mountain. Base level 200, Renewal.
